supplemental_items.interpretation: Read transition from primary result with None default. Only non-null transition whose index<=visible end replaces entire directions mapping via reversed regime builder with state.live_stages supplied. Candidates enumerate resulting mapping and each group's calculationSegments (absent fallback singleton group, not falsy fallback); tuple uses calculationStartIndex absent default -1 and direction. max compares tuples lexicographically, so ties choose greatest direction string, not last encountered. Default (-1,target with absent bullish fallback) is used only for empty candidates; target lookup is still evaluated for default argument. Extract second tuple element. No activeDirection added on non-reversal path.
